name: Prostu★dent Good
source:
The year is 2005 in Japan. The world has received word that aliens shall invade Earth. Therefore, Japan set up a robot group called Yugoku to fend off the aliens when they come. However, the aliens never came, so Yugoku was all for nothing. Meanwhile, the Japanese government was totally corrupted, and Yugoku decided to use their robot army to overthrow the government.

[Edited from [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=205&style=platform]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
时间是2005年的日本。世界收到消息，外星人即将入侵地球。日本因此组建了一支名为“Yugoku”的机器人部队，准备在外星人到来时进行抵抗。然而外星人始终没有出现，Yugoku也因此失去意义。与此同时，日本政府已彻底腐败，于是Yugoku决定利用机器人军队推翻政府。

[编辑自[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=205&style=platform]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
